LiZhao2026Adaptive gives general adaptive design-based IPW/AIPW inference, and Liu2026CovariateAdaptive gives static two-stage covariate-adaptive inference; neither states this repeated outcome-adaptive fixed-half saturation law with lag-one sustained exposures.
LiDingRubin2018 establishes static hard-rerandomization projection geometry, not the predictable soft-tilt joint-score identity with fixed-count second-stage noise.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:joint-design-clt; thm:studentizer; thm:wald-coverage
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The asymptotic conclusions are conditional on joint G,B growth, predictable covariance stabilization, and a positive-definite limiting covariance.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Root-GB normality and conservative Wald coverage hold under the stated triangular-array regularity conditions, not for arbitrary fixed-market or degenerate-variance deployments.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:projection-covariance
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The gain matrix P depends on unobserved potential-outcome scores and is not an ex ante observable screening statistic in the present core.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The iff c'Pc>0 is a population design-comparison characterization, not a deployable contrast-selection rule without a separately developed proxy or estimation result.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies minimax design with spillover and carryover effects, establishes HT asymptotics, and proposes conservative variance estimators under its design.
The paper establishes finite-population IPW/AIPW theory for general adaptive designs and explicitly includes sequential rerandomization among covered designs.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv v7, 15 January 2026; corroborating the cited Journal of Econometrics article
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies two-stage covariate-adaptive randomization under homogeneous partial interference, with asymptotic normality and variance estimation for primary and spillover effects.
The paper provides randomization-based unbiased estimators and conservative variance estimators for direct and spillover quantities in two-stage experiments.
The paper develops Berry-Esseen results for linear permutational statistics and quadratic functions of design-based estimators.
The paper derives Stein-method Berry-Esseen bounds for heterogeneous stratified linear permutation statistics.
The paper studies design-based two-stage network interference with linear weighted estimators, central limit theorems, and conservative variance estimation under static randomization schemes.
